deals.headline: Flamengo and Fluminense sign 20-year Maracanã concession
deals.investor: Consórcio Fla-Flu (Flamengo and Fluminense), via Fla-Flu Serviços S.A.
deals.seller: Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro
deals.summary: The Fla-Flu consortium won the state tender and signed a 20-year concession to run Maracanã and Maracanãzinho through an SPE, Fla-Flu Serviços S.A.; the tender requires about R$186m of investment by the end of the concession.

deals.evidence: o valor de R$ 138,1 milhões pagos à vista no leilão do terreno, em julho de 2024, aumentou
deals.headline: Flamengo buys Gasômetro site for its own stadium
deals.seller: Caixa Econômica Federal (FGTS) / Prefeitura do Rio de Janeiro expropriation auction
deals.summary: Flamengo paid R$138.1m in cash at the July 2024 auction of the expropriated Gasômetro land (São Cristóvão / Porto Maravilha); a December 2025 conciliation with the FGTS added R$23.6m in five annual instalments. The club targets a ~R$2.2bn stadium opening 2034-2036.

name: Clube de Regatas do Flamengo
notes: Flamengo's 2025 annual report PDF (https://images.flamengo.com.br/public/arquivos/transparencia/24/1774966356070.pdf) is behind a GoCache block and over 10 MB, so revenue, EBITDA, surplus and net debt are taken from Lance!'s report of the published statements (CNN Brasil gives the same R$2.089bn revenue and R$336m surplus); recurring revenue was R$1.571bn and player sales R$519m. Not found on a citable page: wages, revenue breakdown, legal entity/CNPJ, social follower totals, attendance, title count, CEO. Shirt sponsor not recorded: the club's master-partner notice could not be read, and a Lance! headline (Sept 2026) has the football director discussing the impact of the end of betting sponsorships, so the current sponsor is unclear. Kit supplier (adidas) not confirmed on a page read. A November 2024 agreement with the city lets Flamengo sell the Gávea building potential (about R$500m expected, Agência Brasil) to fund the stadium; not recorded as a deal because the figure is a projection. The earlier record's ESPN/Sports Value BRL valuation was replaced with Sports Value's own page (US$). flamengo.com.br blocks scripted fetches (GoCache 403); the owners and chair evidence were read on the club's 15 Sept 2026 news page through a browser-style fetch, so an automated re-check may fail there.

owners.evidence: O Conselho Deliberativo do Flamengo aprovou, nesta terça-feira (15), o Texto Substitutivo da reforma estatutária
owners.name: Members of Clube de Regatas do Flamengo (associação)

ownership_summary: Clube de Regatas do Flamengo is a members' association and has not converted its football into an SAF; it is governed by its elected president (Luiz Eduardo Baptista, 'Bap') and Conselho Deliberativo, which in September 2026 approved a statute reform making a paid professional executive board permanent. No outside investor holds equity in the football club.
